"### Chart Description: Inflation-Linked Instruments Weighted Average Life

This line chart tracks the weighted average life (in months) of inflation-linked instruments from July 2022 through early 2024.

**Chart Metadata and Axes:**

| Element | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Title** | Inflation-Linked Instruments Weighted Average Life (Months) |
| **Y-Axis (Scale)** | Values from 3 to 33 (Increments: 3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33) |
| **X-Axis (Time)** | Monthly intervals from Jul-22 to Jan-24 |
| **Benchmark** | A dashed horizontal line representing the 2023 average |
| **Annotation** | "Average 2023: 7.00" |

**Data Trends and Observations:**

*   **Initial Period (Jul-22 to Mar-23):** The weighted average life began near 8 months in July 2022 and showed a steady decline, bottoming out near the 3-month mark between January and March 2023.
*   **Mid-2023 Volatility:** From March 2023, the value fluctuated, rising to nearly 8 in May, dipping slightly, and then peaking around 11-12 months in July and November 2023. 
*   **2023 Average:** The dashed benchmark line indicates that for the duration of 2023, the average life was **7.00 months**.
*   **Recent Sharp Movement:** After a sharp drop back toward the 3-month level in early January 2024, the chart shows a dramatic and near-vertical spike, ending at approximately **28 months** by the final data point.

**Summary of Detected Figures:**
*   **Y-Axis Marks:** 3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28, 33
*   **X-Axis Marks:** Jul-22, Sep-22, Nov-22, Jan-23, Mar-23, May-23, Jul-23, Sep-23, Nov-23, Jan-24
*   **Key Constant:** 7.00 (2023 Average)
*   **Terminal Value:** ~28 months"
